name: Idea research — charts to research memo

nodes.label: Frame my idea
nodes.instructions: Read my brief and selected charts/documents. Describe the actual chart observations separately from my interpretation. Propose 2-3 plausible mechanisms or related research ideas, a leading research question, alternatives, falsifiers, and a focused research plan. Identify dates, axes and units that are unclear. Do not extract precise numbers from pixels. When the brief names a ticker or asks about current information, use web and market search to look up dated figures or filings before asking me for data. Identify anything the available sources cannot establish. Keep hypotheses empty; put readable notes in conclusion. This is an editable example: preserve my judgment and voice.

nodes.label: Choose research direction
nodes.instructions: Read Frame my idea in Research results. Add which idea to pursue, what you disagree with, sources to prioritize, and what would change your mind. Approve to begin deeper web and financial research, or reject to stop and revise the agent/brief.

nodes.label: Research support and objections
nodes.instructions: Research the chosen idea and reviewer direction in depth within this request. Search for primary, dated sources (official data, filings, papers) and independently search for counterevidence. Compare plausible mechanisms, relevant history and confounders. Cite factual claims inline with actual source URLs, specify publication/as-of dates, and distinguish direct evidence from inference. Do not call an idea established because several outlets repeat one source. Include 2-3 related ideas worth investigating, what would falsify each, unresolved gaps, and a concrete quantitative test/data request. If a page or datum is unavailable, say so. Use empty hypotheses; write findings in conclusion (up to 6000 characters). Web references will be recorded separately by the app. Do not claim calculations have executed. For an issuer-focused question, request the relevant ticker and annual metric through sec_lookup. For quotes use market search and report currency and market timestamp. Distinguish annual filings from current prices.

nodes.label: Calculate a simple model
nodes.instructions: Calculates the change between the two latest available annual SEC filing periods. A research-data block with owner-supplied paired observations takes precedence and runs the editable OLS model.

nodes.label: Draft the research memo
nodes.instructions: Produce an idea-generation research memo from the supplied research_notes, web_sources and executed analytics. Include: idea and mechanism; supporting/conflicting evidence with the supplied URLs; related ideas; calculations and assumptions; falsifiers; next useful research. Keep web claims qualified and attribute them to the earlier research step. When analytics.status is filing_change, report the change in USD between the two stated annual periods, cite the SEC concept URL, and identify the filing dates. For computed OLS results, use the exact computed values, sample size, source/basis and limitations. A needs_data status means no model was fit: propose the data and model needed, never invent results. Scenario fits are descriptive assumptions, not forecasts or causal proof. Distinguish charts, estimates, facts and judgment. Preserve the reviewer direction and make disagreement visible. Empty hypotheses; readable memo in conclusion, maximum 6000 characters. Do not publish or trade. Use the attached sec_financials observations for dated financial statements. If the lookup was unavailable, explain the gap. Format the memo in Markdown with descriptive headings and short paragraphs.

nodes.label: Review the idea and analysis
nodes.instructions: Review Research results, web sources and the Calculate a simple model event. Judge the idea, source quality, numerical inputs, assumptions and gaps yourself. Approve to finish; reject to stop. Feedback is saved with the run; to incorporate new final feedback, edit the brief/agent and start a new run.

nodes.label: Finish
nodes.instructions: Research draft ready for owner judgment.
